facts.business: Abram Food Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a diversified portfolio of food grains, pulses, flour, spices, cattle feed, and edible oils marketed under the brand name 'Kherliwala' in Rajasthan, Delhi/NCR, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana.
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 for all transactions with related parties and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
